correctness.rationale: The given source expression f_k(theta)+1=k(1+theta²)^(k-1)(theta²-1)²/[2^k theta^(k+1)+(1+theta²)^(k+1)] exactly becomes 2k*x^(k-1)*(x²-1)/(1+2*x^(k+1)) for x=(theta+theta^-1)/2. Thus numerator H_k and strictly positive denominator. H_k(1)=-3, tends to infinity, H_k prime=2(k-1)x^(k-2)[(k+1)x²-k]>0 on x>=1. At root x_k, A=(k-1)x_k²-k>0 with 2x_k^(k-1)A=1. For B=k*x_k²-(k+1)=A+(x_k²-1)>A, H_(k+1)(x_k)+1=x_k B/A>1, so x_(k+1)<x_k, giving strict reciprocal endpoint nesting. Independently evaluated the rational algebraic identity exactly and computed roots k=2..11 (strictly decreasing x), without using finite data as proof. The result concerns sufficient extremality only and leaves endpoints/necessity unresolved.
